plainTranslation: Words grate against action. The Mercury person feels pushed or talked over; the Mars person finds the other's talk slow or provoking. Sharp exchanges and a quick rise to friction. Failure mode: a couple who argue for sport and wound with words. Workable if both slow the reflex to snap; debate the idea, not the person.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The invitation of this aspect is deeper self-understanding. It shows you where your nervous system speeds up before your mind has a chance to catch up. It reveals the stories you tell yourself about being misunderstood, criticized, or unheard. And it asks both people to become more conscious of how they speak, listen, and respond.
advice: The growth here comes from not reacting to every disagreement. This person will get under your skin sometimes. You will probably do the same to them. If both of you can stay in the conversation instead of immediately defending yourselves, you can learn a lot from the differences between you.
